tools.name: search_records
tools.title: Search biomedical records
tools.description: Search genes, proteins, drugs, diseases, phenotypes, pathways, variants, pharmacogenomics, GWAS, diagnostics, adverse events, studies, patents or authors by text; returns IDs for get_record (variants: get_variant_evidence). Papers: search_literature. Trials: search_trials. Patent search is chemistry-linked (SureChEMBL); assignee/inventor/CPC search is query_source(source=patents). e.g. {"entity":"gene","query":"BRCA1","filters":{"species":9606}}

source.description: One source ID; omit to query all.

output.description: summary trims excerpts; full keeps source fields. Omitted evidence stays recoverable.

tools.name: get_record
tools.title: Get record and evidence sections
tools.description: Fetch one record by ID with optional evidence sections, e.g. gene expression/eqtl/diseases/druggability, drug label/safety, article fulltext, trial eligibility, protein domains/structures. Variants: get_variant_evidence. List an entity's sections with get_capabilities(entity=...). e.g. {"entity":"gene","id":"PCSK9","species":9606}

tissue_id.description: GTEx tissue, e.g. Liver; required for gene_tissue.

FulltextParameters.description: One-based inclusive lines, end >= start, up to 100. Defaults: 1–100.

view.description: outline lists sections; lines reads start-end; assets lists figures.

id.description: Exact ID, e.g. PCSK9, PMID:123, NCT04368728, MONDO:0007750, Q8NBP7, R-HSA-109581 or an InChIKey.

sections.description: Empty returns the base record; get_capabilities(entity=...) lists sections.

sources.description: Restrict lookups to these source IDs.

tools.name: search_literature
tools.title: Search literature
tools.description: Search papers across PubMed, Europe PMC, PubTator and LitSense with date, author, journal, article-type and open-access filters. Deduplicates across sources and reports each source's outcome. Read abstracts or full text with get_record(entity=article). e.g. {"query":"PCSK9 LDL cholesterol"}

source.description: One source ID; omit to query all.

output.description: summary trims excerpts; full keeps source fields. Omitted evidence stays recoverable.

tools.name: search_trials
tools.title: Search clinical trials
tools.description: Search clinical trials (ClinicalTrials.gov, NCI) by condition, intervention, phase and recruitment status. Read arms, eligibility or outcomes with get_record(entity=trial). Does not assess an individual's eligibility. e.g. {"query":"familial hypercholesterolemia","filters":{"status":"RECRUITING"}}

source.description: One source ID; omit to query all.

output.description: summary trims excerpts; full keeps source fields. Omitted evidence stays recoverable.

tools.name: get_variant_evidence
tools.title: Get variant evidence
tools.description: Get evidence for one variant (rsID, gene + protein change, HGVS or chr:pos:ref:alt). Defaults: ClinVar, gnomAD population, CIViC; add predictions (AlphaMissense), eve, cosmic, oncokb, hotspots, gwas or cbioportal. Ambiguous assembly or transcript is reported, not guessed; predictions keep source and uncertainty. e.g. {"id":"PCSK9 R46L"}

cursor.description: Continuation from a previous CIViC page.

id.description: rsID, gene + protein change (PCSK9 R46L), HGVS or chr:pos:ref:alt.

sources.description: Restrict lookups to these source IDs.

tools.name: analyze_study
tools.title: Analyze genomics study
tools.description: Analyze an installed public cancer genomics study: gene_profile, mutation_cohort, survival, compare, co_occurrence, filter_cohort, top_mutated. List installed studies with get_capabilities(source=study); ubi_synthetic is invented demo data. Report sample denominators and exclusions. Private data analysis uses the Ubi platform. e.g. {"analysis":"gene_profile","study":"ubi_synthetic","gene":"TP53"}

tools.name: resolve_entity
tools.title: Resolve identifiers
tools.description: Map a name, alias or ambiguous identifier to exact species-qualified IDs before joining evidence. Returns candidates when ambiguous; a provider match score alone is not identity. Skip when you already hold an exact ID. e.g. {"entity":"gene","query":"LDL receptor","species":9606}

tools.name: find_related
tools.title: Find related records
tools.description: List records linked to one record. gene/drug/disease: articles, trials. variant: articles, structure. article: citations, references, recommendations, authors, entities. author: articles. Record attributes are get_record sections, not relations. e.g. {"entity":"article","id":"PMID:123","relation":"references"}

id.description: Record ID, e.g. PCSK9, PMID:123 or openalex:A123.

tools.name: build_dossier
tools.title: Build research dossier
tools.description: Build a multi-section dossier in one call: verified identity, default record sections and top related papers, with citations and per-source outcomes. Workflows: target_dossier, model_input_bundle (gene), drug_review, disease_landscape, pathway_review, variant_dossier, negative_evidence (bounded literature check; never proves absence). Add sections with get_record. e.g. {"workflow":"target_dossier","focus":"LDLR","species":9606}

cursor.description: Continuation from a previous CIViC page.

tissue_id.description: GTEx tissue, e.g. Liver; required for gene_tissue.

FulltextParameters.description: One-based inclusive lines, end >= start, up to 100. Defaults: 1–100.

view.description: outline lists sections; lines reads start-end; assets lists figures.

focus.description: Gene symbol, drug, disease (MONDO ID or name), pathway (R-HSA ID or exact name), variant, or topic.

tools.name: query_source
tools.title: Query source directly
tools.description: Run a source-specific operation that other tools do not cover, e.g. ChEMBL bioactivities, Ensembl coordinates, PDB structure quality, OmniPath interactions, NCBI Datasets genomes, ncbi-records for GenBank/GEO/SRA. Read get_capabilities(source=...) for operations and params first. e.g. {"source":"gtex","operation":"get_metadata","params":{"info_type":"tissues","dataset_id":"gtex_v10"}}

tools.name: run_batch
tools.title: Run batched reads
tools.description: Run up to ten independent read calls in parallel with one quota reservation; each result keeps its own outcome. build_dossier and utilities are not batchable. e.g. {"calls":[{"operation":"get_record","arguments":{"entity":"gene","id":"PCSK9","species":9606}}]}

idempotency_key.description: Reuse when retrying so quota is charged once.

tools.name: get_capabilities
tools.title: Inspect get_capabilities
tools.description: List enabled sources, entity sections, dossier workflows and source operations with exact parameter schemas. Narrow with source or entity; diagnose=true probes source health. Examples: biomedmcp://guide. e.g. {}

tools.name: get_quota
tools.title: Check quota
tools.description: Show remaining research allowance and reset times; signed-in accounts get higher limits. e.g. {}

budget_decision: 96 KiB bounds the 13-tool catalog with self-contained evidence-receipt schemas; 40 KiB bounds the model-visible part (names, titles, descriptions, input schemas and annotations). Claude tool definitions and default Codex function tools omit output schemas; Codex code mode renders them into TypeScript declarations. Parameter descriptions are short so repeated fields stay cheap. run_batch advertises only its envelope because each item is validated against its own tool schema; resolve_entity advertises a strictly looser schema without typed record families, which the server still enforces. Task impact remains unqualified. Selected literature and trial registry metadata is typed; other inner scientific record coverage remains open. Equivalent nullable shorthand and omission of redundant annotations preserve constraints. FastMCP retains self-contained local definitions, with no external schema references.
